browser.execution: Codex-assisted local Chrome, Auth and Firestore Emulators

results.name: verified emulator authentication
results.actual: Signup requests a local verification code; applying that code and checking verification opens the app.
results.method: Real local Auth Emulator, not Gmail/Google or inbox delivery

results.name: authenticated published-event core path
results.actual: Dashboard, category/search and Event Details show the seeded emulator event and its location.

results.name: empty-search recovery
results.actual: A search with no matches shows an empty state; Clear filters restores published and sample events.

results.name: refresh and restored session
results.actual: The verified local session and server-backed published event return after reload.
results.method: Auth/Firestore Emulators, not deployed Google-session proof

results.name: application permission-denied runtime
results.actual: The actual emulator query returns permission-denied; the application displays its terminal error and Retry while sample listings remain available.
results.method: Changed rules only in dedicated local emulator; same-query SDK diagnostic, unmodified App/store

results.name: Retry after permission restoration
results.actual: Clicking the real Retry control reconnects the application, restores the published event and removes the terminal alert.
results.method: Unmodified application and restored local repository rules

results.name: application terminal loading-error runtime
results.actual: A controlled failed-precondition callback produces the actual application error UI and Retry control.
results.method: Browser-controlled store-boundary injection; not a real Firestore/provider failure

results.name: Retry after controlled loading error
results.actual: Retry starts the original SDK listener, loads the emulator event and clears the alert.
results.method: Injected first callback only; recovery uses actual local Firestore

results.name: logout
results.actual: Logout returns to the landing view.

setupNotes: Firebase CLI 15.36.0; Java 21.0.6; Node v20.18.0; existing dependency install reused.
Initial globally installed older CLI could not replace a JAR held by a separate emulator. The completed run used the current cached CLI and dedicated ports.
Only selected local Auth/Firestore instances on ports 19499/18480 and Vite 5390 were started/stopped. No production rules, database, account, billing or provider settings changed.
Raw Firebase CLI logs and environment data are private and excluded from published artifacts.
